nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index of the project's technical documentation, directing readers to architecture, development, training, model-bundle, and deployment guidance.

nodes.name: architecture.archify.json
nodes.summary: Archify source configuration for the customer-churn training and serving architecture diagram, including components, connections, evidence links, and boundary cards.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON uses an Archify-specific diagram schema with source-line evidence and positioned visual components.

nodes.name: architecture.html
nodes.summary: Generated interactive HTML architecture diagram showing the churn data split, classical and foundation-model training paths, evaluation, persisted artifacts, and Streamlit serving.
nodes.languageNotes: Large generated HTML artifact embeds SVG diagram structure, source evidence, styling, and client-side interaction logic.

nodes.name: architecture.md
nodes.summary: Architecture reference describing the churn training pipeline, optional Mitra-v2 and TabFM integrations, Streamlit application boundary, persisted state, and reproducibility constraints.

nodes.name: architecture.visual-check.html
nodes.summary: Generated visual-review report page for the architecture diagram, presenting captured light and dark viewport images and automated containment-check status.

nodes.name: architecture.visual-check.json
nodes.summary: Machine-readable visual-check result for architecture.html, recording artifact identity, browser state, viewport containment, readability diagnostics, captures, and sidecars.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON records a structured automated visual-review result with per-viewport measurements and diagnostic state.

nodes.name: deployment-runbook.md
nodes.summary: Operational runbook for starting and health-checking Streamlit locally or in a Mitra-enabled Docker container, with troubleshooting for artifacts, CUDA, GPU memory, and input schemas.

nodes.name: developer-guide.md
nodes.summary: Contributor setup and validation guide covering uv environments, CUDA-aware foundation-model prerequisites, common commands, project conventions, and deterministic test coverage.

nodes.name: model-bundle-reference.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the trusted schema-v2 models_bundle.pkl payload, including classical estimators, foundation descriptors, preprocessing state, metrics, timings, and compatibility rules.

nodes.name: training-and-evaluation.md
nodes.summary: Training and benchmark guide for classical, Mitra-v2, and TabFM model groups, including command options, artifact reuse, evaluation semantics, and generated outputs.
